QUOTE: The Doxyfile no longer chooses the input set. Since gh#333 it supplies aliases and predefined macros only. An older Doxyfile-as-scope fallback was removed.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the Doxyfile no longer sets the input set, but it never gives the reason: a repo that ships a Doxyfile would get only its documented subset, while a repo with none gets its whole tree.
